description: Make a Claude Code account the global one (it must be signed in): what plain `claude` gets in new tmux windows (tmux's global CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). Panes that follow the global account go along as `move` says: `idle_now_working_after` (default: idle ones move now, resuming their conversation; working or waiting ones after their turn) or `new_only` (they stay where they run, pinned there). Shells already open keep the environment they started with.

GlobalMove.description: How panes that follow the global account go along (D8).

oneOf.description: Idle ones move now, working or waiting ones after their turn.
They stay on the account they run on, pinned there.

move.description: What panes following the global account do (default `idle_now_working_after`).

after_turn.description: Panes that move once their turn ends.

stayed.description: Panes that stay where they run (pinned there with `new_only`, or that can't move).
